training.selection: policy.npz是已记录固定验证集损失最低的参数；完整训练到配置要求的1500次。

evaluation.paired_scenarios: same underlying initial-state, target, radius and noise draws
evaluation.dynamics: MuJoCo native free rigid body + official cf21B_500 controller/actuator wrench
evaluation.integrator: native MuJoCo Euler (semi-implicit rigid body); official explicit Euler RPM
evaluation.execution: native MuJoCo CPU worlds; official controller, wrench and actor on selected JAX device
evaluation.policy_inputs: bounding box history, attitude, angular rates and previous command

metric_protocol.denominator: all sampled episodes, including every failure; no resets
metric_protocol.collision: first relative swept sphere entry at every integration substep
metric_protocol.impact_speed_m_s: collision sphere-center velocity relative to moving target
metric_protocol.drone_collision_speed_m_s: absolute world speed of the drone collision sphere center
metric_protocol.success: any first physical sphere contact; speed is only a diagnostic
metric_protocol.engine_role: MuJoCo mj_step integrates position/quaternion/linear and angular velocity; shared official controller and motor/propeller model generate external wrench. A separate integrator, not independently identified aircraft/actuator dynamics.

telemetry_contract.bbox: received policy box at tick k, with capture noise and causal delivery
telemetry_contract.actions: normalized issued policy action at start of tick k
telemetry_contract.issued_commands: issued [roll,pitch,yaw radians,total thrust N] at tick k
telemetry_contract.executed_commands: actual command at first 500Hz substep of tick k; channels may change later in tick
telemetry_contract.states_body_gyro_rotor_rpm: simulation truth at boundaries j*dt, initial sample j=0
telemetry_contract.target_velocity: constant world m/s; target(t)=initial_target+target_velocity*t; simulation truth only
telemetry_contract.sensor_delay_steps_action_delay_steps: simulation debug only; never actor inputs
telemetry_contract.hardware_timing: camera/gyro/attitude capture age at policy tick; scheduled RPY/T delay in ms; debug only, never actor inputs

native_contact_diagnostic.note: native collision cache at 500Hz poses; primary metric uses swept geometry

stratified.denominator: all sampled episodes; moving groups exclude exactly stationary targets; outside_bins retains nonstandard task settings; empty rates are null

hardware.parameter_status: 按用户选择启用CrazyRL gyro乘性标准差0.1；延迟沿用项目先验，其它新增未知幅度仍为0，均非本机实测标定。

task.size_distribution: log-uniform scale, without a minimum pixel-area filter
task.floor_handling: common vertical reset translation of aircraft and target keeps the whole prescribed target path above floor; no direction rejection or bounce
task.actor: 65 values; bbox/estimated local attitude/body gyro/issued actions only; no target physical size, range or velocity and no ego position/linear velocity
task.contact_speed: drone collision-sphere-center velocity minus target velocity

limitations: 训练、评测和容量记录均来自仿真，不是实机飞行或硬件测量。
MuJoCo独立积分刚体，但与训练共享官方控制器、旋翼响应、力/力矩模型及冻结标称参数。
bbox由理想球体投影生成后加入配置内噪声与延迟，未验证真实视觉检测器。
最小3cm球在120度640像素相机前方1.5/3m处约3.70/1.85像素宽；现有框噪声可与它同量级，保留这些难例不等于已证明实物能够跟踪。
向下轨迹可能把整组初态抬高；任意3D运动需实物场地有足够净空，未引入天花板模型。
gyro乘性标准差0.1来自用户选定的CrazyRL训练先验，并非cf21B实测标定；其它新增未知幅度仍为0，不能声称已验证其非零扰动或实机鲁棒性。
容量短测每档仅3次完整BPTT更新，不能当作收敛性能比较或其它显卡的容量上限。
